name: The Wine-Dark Strait
provenance: Drawn for this format by Claude (Opus 5). The backdrop is my own three.js render — sky painted to a canvas, a displaced sea plane lit by one directional light, and a galley and sea-beast built from primitives; no external assets, textures or fonts were loaded. The scene is an original composition on a public-domain theme (Homer's Odyssey, the strait between the two perils); no studio's designs, marks or character names are reproduced. Free to use, modify and redistribute.
